scope: static M896 screen only; not a deployable dynamic graph
timer: one fixed ABBA per site, 15 raw samples/leg, first sample retained

llm_backbone_norm_qkv_rope.timing_boundary: full968 RMSNorm -> GEMM A968/B896 -> full968 RoPE/scatter
llm_backbone_norm_qkv_rope.reset_boundary: same projected.zero_ before each timed graph, excluded from A and B
llm_backbone_norm_qkv_rope.finite_tail: zero projected tail makes full968 scatter write finite zero Q/K/V tail
llm_backbone_norm_qkv_rope.same_addresses: A/B share each input/weight plus normed, projected, Q, K and V
llm_backbone_norm_qkv_rope.cache_policy: 18 real weights rotate, 180 MiB; shared working outputs; no L2 flush
llm_backbone_norm_qkv_rope.static_limitation: excluded projected reset supplies a finite tail; no runtime selector

llm_backbone_out_proj_residual.timing_boundary: per-call full968 residual restore -> GEMM A968/B896
llm_backbone_out_proj_residual.reset_boundary: identical residual copy included in each A/B timed call
llm_backbone_out_proj_residual.finite_tail: short GEMM leaves the restored finite residual at rows896:968
llm_backbone_out_proj_residual.same_addresses: A/B share each input/weight/residual and one common working output
llm_backbone_out_proj_residual.cache_policy: 17 real weights rotate, 136 MiB; shared working output; no L2 flush
llm_backbone_out_proj_residual.static_limitation: static prefix view; no runtime selector; physical buffers remain968
